title: Broadcast of CGM-values from AAPS to xDrip not working
symptom: Broadcast of CGM values from AAPS to xDrip stopped working with the Feb 13 nightly, and when it works, xDrip always uploads direction=flat to Nightscout.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but a fix was implemented in a commit.
fix: A fix was implemented in the next nightly (commit dd677e7db2c0c9e607d9eeda5548a67b4256de2d), which resolved both the broadcast and direction arrow issues.
evidence_quote: Nice, that appears to have fixed it. Thank you so much!
